name: pokemon-card-benchmark
description: A dataset of Pokémon trading card images and associated metadata intended to evaluate models on visual recognition and structured information extraction from cards. Tasks include card-type and attribute classification, OCR of card text, and extraction of structured fields (e.g., name, HP, attacks, rarity). The benchmark is useful for testing fine-grained vision, OCR, and information-extraction performance on noisy, real-world images.
reputation: A niche, community-contributed dataset popular among hobbyists and vision researchers for fine-grained recognition and OCR tasks.
